releaseNotes:
## AgentOS Core 2.0.0-beta.58

- Preserves the full published API JSON Schema through persistence, extraction,
  AI SDK structured output, and final validation, including nested array items,
  required properties, numeric enums, references, and additional constraints
- Displays output fields as a shared settings schema tree with consistent row
  spacing and source typography; renaming and deleting ordinary properties
  update the original Schema and keep surviving source bindings intact
- Connects SQL data sources only when a tool is called; connection failures are
  delivered to both Harnesses as tool errors without aborting the conversation,
  while read-only execution and credential invalidation remain enforced
- Loads paginated conversation summaries without reading complete histories,
  retaining title, search, visibility, and message-count semantics
- Includes the local beta.57 Codex workspace-image fix and portable workspace
  filename handling, preserving formal files and surfacing checkpoint failures
- Pins matching Runtime `1.0.0-beta.26`; the local platform continues to reuse
  its exact verified Runtime identity, and existing configuration and data remain
  outside immutable Core release directories

Build source: `83a3c51b4496b1da0618819925b98c5fedf42dd8` (`v2.0.0-beta.58`)

This beta release retains existing configuration, conversations and workspace
data. Host 49 is not upgraded in this release task. Provider-side Cube retirement
limitations are not claimed as fixed by this release.
